The OrderedDict keeps\n    insertion/recency order, with the most recently used entry last.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):\n        if capacity < 1:\n            raise ValueError(\"capacity must be >= 1\")\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.ttl = ttl\n        self.clock = clock\n        self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, expires_at or None)\n\n    def _expiry(self):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return None\n        return self.clock() + self.ttl\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _is_expired(expires_at, now):\n        return expires_at is not None and now >= expires_at\n\n    def _purge_expired(self, now):\n        for key in [k for k, (_, exp) in self._data.items()\n                    if self._is_expired(exp, now)]:\n            del self._data[key]\n\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\n        now = self.clock()\n        try:\n            value, expires_at = self._data[key]\n        except KeyError:\n            return default\n        if self._is_expired(expires_at, now):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return default\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        return value\n\n    def put(self, key, value):\n        now = self.clock()\n        self._purge_expired(now)\n        self._data.pop(key, None)\n        self._data[key] = (value, None if self.ttl is None else now + self.ttl)\n        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:\n            self._data.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        now = self.clock()\n        return sum(1 for _, exp in self._data.values()\n                   if not self._is_expired(exp, now))\n\n    def __contains__(self, key):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return False\n        return not self._is_expired(entry[1], self.clock())\n"}"]]}
